title: Strong coupling of a reconfigurable ${}^{171}$Yb atom array to a tunable telecom-band nanofiber cavity
summary: Nanophotonic cavities provide strong atom-photon coupling in a compact, directly fiber-coupled geometry, while a reconfigurable array of $^{171}$Yb atoms combines high-fidelity gates with a metastable qubit state coupled directly to a telecom-band transition, making the two a natural interface between neutral-atom quantum processors and telecom quantum networks.
